exposure: Sinopharm COVID-19 vaccination (3 months before pregnancy, first trimester, or unvaccinated status)
outcome: indication for admission to neonatal intensive care unit (NICU)
cohort: Pregnant women aged 40 years or younger admitted to Baharloo Hospital, Tehran, in 2023, and their newborns, categorized by maternal Sinopharm vaccination status (vaccinated 3 months pre-pregnancy, vaccinated during the first trimester, or unvaccinated).
finding: There was no association found between Sinopharm vaccination and a higher rate of stillbirth and newborn mortality, but newborns of mothers vaccinated in the first trimester exhibited a significantly lower 5th minute Apgar score.
mod_finding: Unvaccinated individuals showed significant differences in delivery type compared to vaccinated individuals.
followup_time: Perinatal and early neonatal period (outcomes measured at birth and shortly after, including duration of NICU stay)
